notes.title: Small update: New playable character
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New playable character: RoboSync (Free DLC)
[*] Lowered score requirement for 4 stars in level 1-2
[*] Visual improvements
[*] Menu navigation enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Balanced music and cutscene volumes.
[*] Reduced interaction area for truck's internal stairs.
[*] Reduced delay for interaction icon balloon to appear.
[*] Improved tutorial instruction screen for ultrawide resolution.
[*] Fixed customer chewing animation when serving a snack while waiting for the tutorial order.
[*] Fixed visual bug when entering/exiting the truck with an ingredient in front of the door.
[/olist]

notes.title: Monster Meals Update Available!
notes.content:
A new update is here, packed with fresh content! You can now customize your food truck even more and give your chef some stylish new hats. Plus, we’ve added a new setting for those who prefer a cleaner hunting experience. Check out what’s new:

📝 Changelog:
[list]
[*] 🎨 More customization options for the food truck;
[*] 🎩 New hats for the chef;
[*] ⚙️ New option to disable effects when hunting animals.
[/list]

Update now and keep cooking for hungry monsters! 🍖🔥

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed color issue with gray truck.
[*] Fixed bug with skipping the truck upgrade scene.
[*] Fixed issue where the upgrade scene always played if the first level of the next world wasn't completed.
[*] Fixed input icon issue in aiming tutorial when playing in multiplayer mod
[/list]e.

notes.title: The Full Kitchen of Monster Meals!
notes.content:
Step into the Full Kitchen and unleash the ultimate **Monster Meals** experience with this bundle, which includes:

- **Monster Meals Base Game**: Cook, serve, and survive the hungry monster madness.
- **Legendary Arsenal DLC**: Wield 5 epic weapons inspired by gaming's greatest legends.
- **Cowboy Crazy DLC**: Get wild with 10 cowboy-themed weapons and 5 stylish hats.

Whether you're a monster chef newbie or a seasoned kitchen master, this all-in-one collection is your golden ticket to culinary chaos, wild fun, and unforgettable adventures.

notes.title: Monster Meals Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Monster Meals demo is now available for download! Dive into culinary adventures and test your skills in a world full of hungry creatures.

In the demo, you’ll get the chance to:

[list]
[*][b]Hunt Animals:[/b] Find wild creatures and turn them into ingredients for your monstrous meals.
[*][b]Cook and Serve:[/b] Use your culinary skills to prepare delicious dishes and serve them to demanding customers.
[*][b]Team Up:[/b] Play solo or with a friend in cooperative mode, tackling challenges that require teamwork and strategy.
[/list]

Don’t miss the chance to experience Monster Meals before the full release! Download the demo now and let us know what you think. We’re excited to hear your feedback and make the game even better.

And don’t forget to add Monster Meals to your wishlist to stay updated on all news and the full release!

Get ready to cook, serve, and survive!

notes.title: Join Us at RetroCon 2024!
notes.content:
Hello, Monster Meals fans!

We’re excited to announce that we’ll be participating in RetroCon, one of the most anticipated events of the year for all gaming enthusiasts! 🎮✨

[b]📅 Date:[/b] August 3rd and 4th, 2024  
[b]📍 Location:[/b] São Paulo-SP - Centro de Eventos Pro Magno

Come visit us at booth [b]L72[/b] for an exclusive Monster Meals experience! We’ll have a new version of our demo with exciting updates! It’s the perfect chance to play, interact with the team, and give your feedback on the game!

[b]What you can expect:[/b]

- [b]Live demonstration[/b] of Monster Meals with thrilling new features!
- [b]Meet and greet[/b] with the development team.

We can’t wait to see you there and share our passion for Monster Meals. Don’t miss the chance to connect with other fans and experience the game firsthand. See you at RetroCon!

For more details about the event, follow us on social media and stay tuned for updates!

See you soon!

The Giant Warrior Studio Team
